::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Chennai-headquartered firm with offices in Hyderabad and Kochi, licensing interface IP and offering SoC verification services and VLSI training.
:::

## What does this firm design?

MIPI, PCIe, CXL, USB, UFS, Ethernet and DDR IP; design-verification services.
